annotations.description: Container app-b in pod default/app-b-5c7b6b6c46-hw7wv keeps crashing right after start and kubelet is backing off restarts (waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff for over 2 minutes). Evidence to inspect: the container's last logs and exit code, recent Deployment rollouts / config or image changes (rollout history), and events on the pod. Typical causes: bad configuration or environment variables from a recent deploy, a failing dependency during startup, or a broken image. If a recent rollout introduced this, rolling back the Deployment is usually the fastest safe fix.
